## Question

Write `docs/adr/0002-turnkey-owns-the-buck2-version.md` recording the decisions settled on the map (one pinned buck2 release per turnkey revision, resolved from turnkey's own toolbox, not declarable in toolchain.toml, override only via flake-input follows, why: format mirrors like the test-runner protocol must match the producing binary exactly), and add **Pinned buck2 release** to CONTEXT.md. Use /domain-modeling.
